name: week
title: Weekly property desk
subtitle: Fictional demo when seeded. Recorded balances, not a trust ledger.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from property.attention order by due_on,record

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: select * from property.compliance order by record

sections.title: Current rent roll
sections.sql: select code,tenant,property,currency,annual_rent_cents,end_on from property.lease_register where status='active' and start_on<=current_date and end_on>=current_date order by code

sections.title: Outstanding charges
sections.sql: select code,tenant,currency,balance_cents,due_on from property.balances where balance_cents>0 order by due_on

sections.title: Outgoings variances
sections.sql: select code,tenant,currency,recoverable_cents,recovered_cents,variance_cents from property.recovery order by code
